newsitem.title: INDIA: India ACC up 5.59 pct on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: India ACC up 5.59 pct on short-covering.

text.p: Shares of India's largest cement maker Associated Companies Ltd (ACC) rose on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Friday on short-covering by local speculators, brokers said.
The share rose 79 rupees or 5.59 percent on the BSE in early afternoon trade.
"There has been lot of buying interest in ACC among local buyers and a handful of FIIs (foreign institutional investors since last week," said a trader.
"There is nothing happening to the company - ACC should have actually fallen because of the freight rate hike (in the railway budget)."
"It's up only for technical reasons," said another trader with an overseas brokerage.
